objective.text: Keep hidden diagnostic context out of ordinary log context while retaining it for application access.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish context available to application code from context automatically added to logs.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Context contains public request_id and hidden internal_flag. With Laravel’s standard context log processor, what is automatically attached to a log record?

options.text: request_id is included; internal_flag is omitted but remains accessible through hidden-context access.
options.rationale: Hidden context is retained by the repository without being included in the processor’s ordinary log extra data.

options.text: Neither value is logged unless each is repeated in the log call.
options.rationale: The standard context processor adds public context automatically.
options.misconception: The standard context processor adds public context automatically.

options.text: internal_flag is logged as an encrypted string by default.
options.rationale: Hidden context is omitted from ordinary log extras, not automatically encrypted into them.
options.misconception: Hidden context is omitted from ordinary log extras, not automatically encrypted into them.

options.text: Both values are logged because hidden applies only to Eloquent serialization.
options.rationale: Context has its own hidden-data facility independent of Eloquent model serialization.
options.misconception: Context has its own hidden-data facility independent of Eloquent model serialization.
